scenarios.title: A｜怀疑诈骗
scenarios.setting: 陌生人在公共场所主动接近玩家，声称自己遇到了紧急情况，需要玩家帮忙。

turns.text: Hey, sorry. My wallet was stolen and I need money for a train ticket. Can you help me?

turns.prompt: 你想礼貌拒绝陌生人索要钱款的请求，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sorry, I can’t give you any money.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, I can’t give you any money.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: I’m sorry to hear that, but I’m not comfortable giving cash to someone I don’t know.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m sorry to hear that, but I’m not comfortable giving cash to someone I don’t know.
feedback.explanation: “I don't know”如实说明不清楚，避免把猜测说成确定的信息。

choices.text: If you’ve lost your wallet, maybe the station staff can help you.

feedback.naturalExpression: If you’ve lost your wallet, maybe the station staff can help you.
feedback.explanation: 加上条件说明请求或安排的适用范围，让对方可以结合实际限制回应。

choices.text: I can’t help with money, but I can point you toward the information desk.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can’t help with money, but I can point you toward the information desk.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: How do I know you’re telling the truth?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, I can’t give you any money.
feedback.explanation: 表达怀疑是合理的，但直接质疑对方诚实可能激化交流；请求可核实的信息更有用。

turns.text: I swear it’s true. I just need twenty dollars.

turns.prompt: 你想保持拒绝的立场，不继续配合对方，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’m sorry, but I can’t help you with that.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m sorry, but I can’t help you with that.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: No. I’m not giving you money.

feedback.naturalExpression: No. I’m not giving you money.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: You should speak to a member of staff.

feedback.naturalExpression: You should speak to a member of staff.
feedback.explanation: 建议找工作人员，明确指出更合适的求助对象。

choices.text: I’m going to leave now.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m going to leave now.
feedback.explanation: “I’m going to”说明计划或去向，能让对方知道接下来的安排。

scenarios.title: B｜拒绝提供信息 / 金钱
scenarios.setting: 在“可疑陌生人”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“拒绝提供信息 / 金钱”。

turns.text: Okay, then could you transfer me some money? I’ll pay you back. What’s your number?

turns.prompt: 你想明确拒绝向陌生人提供个人信息或金钱，会怎么说？

choices.text: No, I don’t give out my personal information to strangers.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, I don’t give out my personal information to strangers.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

choices.text: I’m not comfortable sharing my phone number.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not comfortable sharing my phone number.
feedback.explanation: “phone number”指电话号码，区别于手机本身。

choices.text: Sorry, I won’t transfer money to someone I don’t know.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, I won’t transfer money to someone I don’t know.
feedback.explanation: “I don't know”如实说明不清楚，避免把猜测说成确定的信息。

choices.text: I’m not going to share any banking information.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not going to share any banking information.
feedback.explanation: “I’m not going to”说明自己决定不做某事，立场比暂时没打算更明确。

choices.text: I don’t want to tell you my informations.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, I don’t give out my personal information to strangers.
feedback.explanation: “information”不可数，不加 -s；不想提供个人信息也可以直接说明自己的界限。

turns.text: Come on, I’m not asking for much.

turns.prompt: 你想明确表达界限，要求对方停止，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’ve already said no.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve already said no.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve already”强调这一步已经做过，能在沟通中确认进度。

choices.text: Please stop asking me for money.

feedback.naturalExpression: Please stop asking me for money.
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

choices.text: My answer isn’t going to change.

feedback.naturalExpression: My answer isn’t going to change.
feedback.explanation: 说明答复不会改变，在已经拒绝之后清楚维持界限。

choices.text: I’m not discussing this any further.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not discussing this any further.
feedback.explanation: “not discussing”表示不愿继续讨论，能直接设定话题边界。

turns.text: Why are you being so suspicious?

turns.prompt: 关于「可疑陌生人」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: I don’t need to explain. I’m leaving now.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t need to explain. I’m leaving now.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t need”说明当前不需要这项服务或物品，避免对方继续安排。

choices.text: I don’t know you, and I’m not comfortable with this.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t know you, and I’m not comfortable with this.
feedback.explanation: “I don't know”如实说明不清楚，避免把猜测说成确定的信息。

choices.text: Please don’t follow me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Please don’t follow me.
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

scenarios.title: C｜离开并寻求帮助
scenarios.setting: 陌生人在被拒绝后仍然跟着玩家。玩家走向附近有工作人员的区域。

turns.text: Excuse me. Could I stay here for a moment? That person has been following me.
Of course. Do you know them?

turns.prompt: 关于「可疑陌生人」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: No. They approached me outside and asked me for money.

feedback.naturalExpression: No. They approached me outside and asked me for money.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: No, I’ve never seen them before.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, I’ve never seen them before.
feedback.explanation: 交代与当前有关的经历或已完成的事，让对方了解这次沟通的背景。

choices.text: I told them I wasn’t interested, but they kept following me.

feedback.naturalExpression: I told them I wasn’t interested, but they kept following me.
feedback.explanation: “kept following”表示持续跟随，说明这一行为并非只出现一瞬间。

choices.text: They asked for money and personal information, and now I don’t feel safe.

feedback.naturalExpression: They asked for money and personal information, and now I don’t feel safe.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

turns.text: Okay. Stay here. Do you want me to call security?

turns.prompt: 你想回应刚才的提议，确认接受或愿意配合，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes, please.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, please.
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

choices.text: Yes. I’d rather not go back outside alone.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I’d rather not go back outside alone.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: Could someone walk with me when I leave?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could someone walk with me when I leave?
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

choices.text: If they keep following me, I’d like to contact the police.

feedback.naturalExpression: If they keep following me, I’d like to contact the police.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

turns.text: Sure. Security is on the way.

turns.prompt: 关于「可疑陌生人」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thank you. I’ll wait here.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. I’ll wait here.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Thanks. I really appreciate the help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I really appreciate the help.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。
